tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: Search open listings (offers) on OLTechX, the Bulgarian tech marketplace. Free-text query in Bulgarian or English (e.g. 'RTX 3060', 'iPhone 13 128GB', 'PS5'), with optional category, condition, city and EUR price range. Returns up to 24 results per page with price, condition, city and URL. When noth

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: Full public details of one listing by id: description, price, condition, specs, delivery, seller type, photos and URL. Phone numbers and emails stay hidden (they are shown on the site after sign-in).

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: All categories with slugs and current listing counts. Use the slug in search_listings.

tools.name: find_models
tools.description: Find catalog models (CPUs, graphics cards, phones, consoles) by name. Returns slugs to use with get_model_prices, estimate_fps and check_build.

tools.name: get_model_prices
tools.description: What a model really costs in Bulgaria: used and new price range and median from open listings and real sales in the last 180 days, plus official specs, gaming score and the cheapest open listings. Accepts a slug or a name.

tools.name: estimate_fps
tools.description: Average FPS of a graphics card (optionally with a specific CPU) at 1080p, 1440p and 4K in games measured by published benchmarks (ComputerBase, HWBen) or estimated from official requirements. Also says whether the CPU or GPU limits performance.

tools.name: list_games
tools.description: Games with FPS data: measured in published tests or estimated from the publisher's official requirements.

tools.name: create_search_alert
tools.description: Get a link that lets the user follow a search on OLTechX: after a free signup (or sign-in) the search is saved and they receive an email and push notification for every new matching listing. Use when nothing fits now, or the user wants to wait for a better price. Does not save anything by itself.

tools.name: check_build
tools.description: Check whether PC parts fit together (socket, chipset, RAM type, case and cooler clearance, power) and get the recommended PSU wattage. CPU and GPU can be catalog model names or slugs; any part can be a listing id from search_listings.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_listings, get_listing, create_search_alert · Public sink: create_search_alert.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_listings, get_listing, create_search_alert · Public sink: create_search_alert

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
